    xxz_chain = XXZChain(num_sites=5, anisotropy=1.0, j=1.0, boundary_condition='open')

    delta_values = np.arange(-2.5, 2.55, 0.25)

        updated_hamiltonian = PauliSumOp(xxz_chain.hamiltonian)

        solver = NumPyEigensolver(k=1)
